B01.title: Data接口与动态metadata边界
B01.boundary_and_ownership: Sole owner of common logical metadata/table/column/projection IDs, scalar tags, limits, provider-neutral session/operation interfaces and outcome declarations in Data.Abstractions and native/database/interfaces. B09 owns query operation descriptors, B07 conversion implementations, B04 owning host. Do not define another metadata schema downstream.
B01.native_reuse: Describe the selected Rust Engine capabilities without implementing a managed provider, SQL parser, SQL AST, dialect or driver.
B01.csharp_surface: DataSource/Session contracts; immutable Table<TEntity>/Column<TEntity,TValue>/Projection<T>; finite capability and limit profile; static materializer contract. Public names remain subject to ordinary API review, while ownership and wire semantics are fixed.
implementation_steps: Extract one canonical metadata schema from D14/D17: format version, content hash, table/column/projection stable IDs, names, codec, nullability, explicit keys and relation descriptors. ABI/package version remains separate from business metadata hash.
Declare one result-shape/row-lease interface consumed by B06/B12. Shape includes column count/order/IDs/aliases, type and nullability; missing nullable fields are not SQL NULL.

Specify physical Session single-command admission and cleanup control separately. Define independent outcome, protocol disposition and local lifetime states for B05; interfaces do not claim completion.

Generate or hand-author equivalent Rust/C# layout/golden fixtures from this one schema, with no whole Core metadata service. Reject duplicate IDs, unknown required codec/profile and checked length overflow.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Descriptor registration copies or retains an explicit owner before synchronous return; errors expose no partial registration or output owner.
No borrowed span, arbitrary CLR type or application pointer survives await. Optional missing fields require an explicit version/default policy; they cannot silently decode NULL.
specific_acceptance: Cross-language metadata golden bytes and malformed inputs; wrong entity/value compile negatives; ABI/profile/version mismatch rejection before DB traffic.
Public abstractions assembly loads without native runtime initialization; real host consumption is verified downstream, without forcing a managed fallback.
B01.dependency_rationale: No product task prerequisite: this is the one shared database seam, implementing accepted specifications. It must not depend on B09 or provider implementations.

B02.title: Rust PostgreSQL执行Adapter
B02.boundary_and_ownership: Own SQLx PostgreSQL provider in native/database/postgres and its narrow managed package; consume B01 seam, B07 binder and B05 transaction policy through B04, without implementing a second host/pool wrapper.
B02.native_reuse: SQLx PgConnection/PgPool/Arguments, wire protocol and native TLS. SeaQuery-generated SQL is bound using B07. Do not recreate PostgreSQL protocol or publish Npgsql as a product path.
B02.csharp_surface: Postgres-specific configuration/capability registration and structured provider details; the application still uses common Session/typed queries.
implementation_steps: Create SQLx options from explicit configuration. Remote production default requires VerifyFull with trusted root and hostname; Prefer/Require are not verified TLS. Secret values never enter errors/manifest.
Implement real prepare/execute/stream over a fixed connection lease, parameter snapshots and structured SQLSTATE mapping, with bounded admission and statement cache policy.

Track ReadyForQuery synchronization and transaction status separately from the application result. Stream drop may need drain before reuse; enforce a cleanup deadline and retire a connection on failure.

Treat timeout/cancellation as a request. Do not invent a public SQLx cancel API from private cancel-key fields. Use explicit server statement_timeout/session policy where selected; cancellation cannot free an active task/connection.
Integrate B04 operation entrypoints; expose safe session-local provider hooks for B05, without sharing SQLx pointers across DLL boundaries.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: 57014 statement timeout inside a transaction leaves it failed (25P02) until rollback; Task completion is not reuse permission.
After COMMIT dispatch without confirmation, report Unknown; connection close or successful cleanup rollback cannot prove original business rollback.
SQLx Execute limit=0 is not server fetch batching. Application row/byte budgets do not prove a whole-process RSS bound or instantaneous server cancellation.
specific_acceptance: Use the real six PostgreSQL Design cases as regression oracles: timeout/rollback, early stream drop, codecs, response-loss durable COMMIT, conflict CTE snapshot and migration lock cleanup.
Add product TLS negative tests: wrong hostname, untrusted root, expired chain and explicit plaintext-development opt-in; Windows/Linux AOT remote PG with actual server identity.
Session reuse test must compare backend PID, not merely observe a subsequent query success. Broken/drain-timeout sessions are quarantined and pool permits eventually return.
B02.dependency_rationale: Preserve local implementation prerequisites; run composition acceptance with actual providers without blocking unrelated implementation work. The graph requires a DAG over start+acceptance: do not add a reverse accepted-status dependency to B04 or from B07 to its provider consumers. Native/component acceptance uses the real pinned upstream backend or a small ABI test fixture; the complete host AOT/NuGet composition is a downstream B04/B21/B24 gate with these exact component commits.

B03.title: Rust SQLite执行Adapter
B03.boundary_and_ownership: Own SQLite native provider, connection options, worker-specific hooks and adapter test fixtures; use the B04 host and shared transaction/stream/codec components.
B03.native_reuse: SQLx SQLite worker, SQLite prepared statements, progress hooks and transaction machinery. No unconditional Task.Run wrapper and no separate C# database execution engine.

implementation_steps: Pin libsqlite3-sys/SQLite build features and actual SQLite version in the native package. Configure FK/WAL/busy profile explicitly on every physical connection; validate in-memory pooling semantics.
Implement one active operation per physical connection and bounded native command admission. Account separately for queued item count, input bytes and driver allocations.

Use an operation-generation-scoped progress cancellation flag installed/removed on the worker. An old cancel request cannot affect a new tenant. Do not promise interruption at every native instruction.

Separate Future drop, queued rollback, worker connection destruction, shutdown ACK and OS-thread join evidence. Close awaits only facts the API can actually observe; do not label an unavailable JoinHandle as joined.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Synchronous bounded-channel send can block its caller; a Tokio timeout cannot preempt that code. Reserve capacity or use a controlled worker path and avoid blocking finalizer/reverse-callback threads.
busy/locked/progress-interrupt errors preserve provider detail and require transaction cleanup; per-connection FK/savepoint behavior is tested.
Huge cells may already be allocated inside SQLite/SQLx before boundary rejection; report observed allocation separately from the owned-batch budget.
specific_acceptance: Reuse existing database-retirement six-case two-OS research as oracle definitions, then execute actual product paths for commit Future drop, rollback/pool reuse, progress cancellation, early stream drop and shutdown.
Windows/Linux AOT use file-backed concurrent connections plus documented in-memory cases; foreign-key failure/savepoint recovery and native migration checksum/failing-DDL tests.
Same-connection reuse uses a persistent physical-connection marker; a fresh connection succeeding is not the oracle.

B04.title: 必需Rust Database Host与生命周期
B04.boundary_and_ownership: Own mandatory native database host, Engine-local runtime, physical lease admission, resource tree and managed facade bridge. B01 defines seams; B02/B03 implement providers; B05/B06/B07 implement transaction/stream/codec components. Never define provider interfaces in B04 that the providers need before B04 exists.
B04.native_reuse: Tokio runtime only within the async DB Engine, SQLx native pools, Core narrow owner/async primitives. Sync Engines elsewhere need not acquire this runtime.
B04.csharp_surface: DataSource.Open/Session acquisition and async execute facades; internal opaque SafeHandles and Operation<T>; no public Rust runtime or driver trait.
implementation_steps: Bind create/start/request_cancel/typed take_result/try_retire/release with out owners null on failure and one successful transfer. Registration/start return and callback/control leases both participate in managed retirement.
Model DataSource closing and single-command Session admission explicitly. SafeHandle protects lifetime but does not authorize concurrent mutable Rust access.
Keep session/cursor/transaction/operation parent ownership until native cleanup finishes. A transferred cursor/batch owns an independent parent lease after operation retirement.
Expose bounded Engine-local runtime/pool configuration, shutdown deadline, diagnostics and reject-on-closing behavior; do not introduce a compulsory global Core executor.
Compose providers through B01 seam. Integrator connects workspace manifests; task worktrees must not each regenerate shared Cargo.lock or solution files.
Reuse A02 negotiated Engine loader/bootstrap and lifetime; do not implement a second module loader or capability protocol.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Request cancellation never releases input, native context, parent lease or cancellation registration while access is possible.
Close rejects new work but permits cleanup control; unconfirmed remote effect may remain Unknown after safe local retirement.
A child owner outliving public parent disposal remains safely alive or fails new admission; finalizer performs no blocking async join.
specific_acceptance: Real two-provider cross-language AOT create/execute/transfer/retire paths with synchronous and asynchronous completion, already-cancelled tokens, duplicate completion, start failure and callback/control races.
Count native allocations, live parent leases, handles, callbacks and pending operations through fail injection; product integration uses actual B02/B03/B05/B06.
NuGet consumer runs without Cargo and without auto-building an entity-specific engine.
B04.dependency_rationale: Keep the established Core prerequisites. Provider, transaction and streaming implementations are local acceptance gates, not a B04 start cycle: all consume the accepted B01 seam.

B05.title: Rust事务、池恢复与Unknown
B05.boundary_and_ownership: Own transaction lifecycle/outcome/recovery and connection disposition policy in native/database/transactions; provider hooks remain B01 interfaces. Keep response-loss uncertainty out of generic Core status definitions.
B05.native_reuse: SQLx transaction/savepoint/pool mechanics and native provider hooks. SeaORM TransactionTrait is only relevant to an explicit specialized profile, not mandatory for ordinary adapters.
B05.csharp_surface: Typed transaction scope, CommitAsync result distinguishing Committed/RolledBack/Unknown, recoverable correlation data and explicit retry advice; no automatic replay of arbitrary business delegates.
implementation_steps: Implement distinct state dimensions: transaction Active/CommitDispatched/Finalizing/Closed; durable outcome; protocol Reusable/NeedsDrain/Retire; local active leases/callbacks/retirement.
Record COMMIT dispatch before awaiting its response. Known confirmation chooses committed outcome; cancellation/error after dispatch with no definitive evidence remains Unknown.
Perform rollback/drain/probe through cleanup admission on the original session; release the pool permit only when the connection is reusable or physically retired.
Implement explicit savepoints and isolation capabilities. SQLite Deferred/Immediate mode is not a simulated PostgreSQL isolation matrix.

Expose application idempotency recovery using stable operation ID, tenant/key and request hash. Conflicting INSERT/SELECT in one Read Committed CTE can miss the winner; use a separate recovery SELECT after conflict.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Drop queues rollback; it is not rollback confirmation. Subsequent cleanup, no-active-transaction response or connection close does not retroactively resolve an Unknown commit.
Old cancellation generation and reused session must be isolated; rollback/drain failure means retire, not return to next tenant.
Unknown can be durably recorded while local native/managed resources retire; keeping an undecidable business result does not require leaking the operation.
specific_acceptance: Actual product response-loss proxy forwards COMMIT and drops all reply frames after server durable completion; separate connection proves effect and client returns Unknown without retry.
Same-session failed transaction rollback and reuse, dropped active transaction, savepoint recovery, acquire cancellation, pool close and stale cancel races on both providers.
Cross-language model/oracle maps actual code transitions to C-TX invariants; finite state exploration does not claim weak-memory or soak proof.
B05.dependency_rationale: Preserve local implementation prerequisites; run composition acceptance with actual providers without blocking unrelated implementation work. The graph requires a DAG over start+acceptance: do not add a reverse accepted-status dependency to B04 or from B07 to its provider consumers. Native/component acceptance uses the real pinned upstream backend or a small ABI test fixture; the complete host AOT/NuGet composition is a downstream B04/B21/B24 gate with these exact component commits.

B06.title: Rust有界结果批次与流
B06.boundary_and_ownership: Own native cursor and owned row-batch implementation plus C# stream adapter; B01 owns shape/lease contracts and B12 owns DTO construction. Do not put DTO mapping inside drivers.
B06.native_reuse: SQLx row streams/SQLite worker; native checked row codecs from B07. No unbounded fetch_all on the streaming path.
B06.csharp_surface: IAsyncEnumerable<T> adapter or explicit Cursor.FetchAsync/OwnedRowBatch, with one active fetch and one untransferred result, explicit large-value chunks.
implementation_steps: Maintain row and byte budgets together, including descriptor/cell/payload checked sizes. Stop adding a row before it exceeds the batch budget; use explicit chunk support or LargeValueRequiresStreaming for a single oversized field.
Shape-check count/order/IDs/aliases/type before first nullable read, then expose borrowed typed views only under the owned batch lease.
Transfer each completed batch at most once. Consumer break, cancellation or mapper exception closes the cursor and retains cleanup owners until protocol drain/retirement.
Use bounded batch/operation counts and bytes. Document SQLx PG Execute limit=0 and internal buffering so owned-batch limits are not represented as entire-RSS limits.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Decoder/constructor failure releases the current batch, stops further fetches and cleans up cursor/session; do not free still-borrowed native bytes.
Slow consumers apply admission backpressure; close/cancel may require provider cleanup after the enumerable has stopped yielding.
All batch offset/length arithmetic is checked; malformed UTF8, unknown codec and NULL/nonnullable mismatch are structured failures.
specific_acceptance: Empty/one/multibatch results, huge field, slow consumer, early break, mapping throw and duplicate take/dispose through real PG/SQLite product paths.
Assert bounded owned bytes and live owners separately from measured native driver/whole-process memory; downstream B22/B23 retain sustained RSS/workload gates.
Windows/Linux AOT typed enumeration and clean NuGet consumer; no Span or borrowed pointer survives await/dispose.

B07.title: Rust fallible参数codec与边界值
B07.boundary_and_ownership: Sole owner of Rust logical-value to provider Arguments conversion and checked Rust/C# wire scalar conversion. B11 invokes this binder; do not duplicate it in query code or silently use a panic-prone convenience adapter.
B07.native_reuse: SeaQuery Value/SQLx Encode/Type and provider native codecs; propagate every Arguments::add Result. Use explicit finite capability profiles.
B07.csharp_surface: Static logical scalar/value readers/writers, typed null and explicit supported enum/JSON registration; no object[] or auto-stringify fallback.
implementation_steps: Implement the D14 finite scalar table with explicit size/range/endianness and NULL rules. UUID uses RFC/network bytes; distinguish CLR Guid layout.

Choose checked decimal domain and timestamp precision policy. PG arbitrary numeric is wider than rust_decimal; reject unrepresentable values. Reject sub-microsecond precision where the contract promises lossless conversion rather than silently truncating.
Use explicit SQLite decimal-as-text and timestamp profile rather than relying on dynamic SQLite affinity for precision. Nonfinite floats follow explicit backend capability policy.
Validate utf8, lengths, unknown tags, unsigned narrowing, encoded argument count/bytes before send; cleanup any partially constructed argument owner on failure.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: A valid nullable slot containing SQL NULL differs from a missing column; shape preflight belongs to B06/B12.
No unwrap/panic on user values; caught panic is exceptional containment, not normal codec validation.
Cancellation can retire a pending operation only after input copies/leases are no longer used; argument buffer reuse is per execution.
specific_acceptance: Every supported scalar positive/negative and boundary value against real both databases; compare static C# values, wire, SQLx native bind and returned values.
Run UUID endianness, huge PG numeric, typed NULL and nanosecond→microsecond loss controls from the actual Design PG fixture; fuzz length/tag/arithmetic separately.
Checked input failures occur before DB sends and preserve zero leaked argument/result owners.

B08.title: Rust迁移执行与版本ledger
B08.boundary_and_ownership: Own explicit deployment migration runner and ledger policy; never automatic destructive schema synchronization in ordinary DataSource startup. Keep administration pools/sessions separate from request transactions.
B08.native_reuse: SQLx Migrator/Migrate, native migration checksums, provider transactional DDL and ledger. Provider-specific locking is inspected, not assumed identical.
B08.csharp_surface: Explicit MigrationDefinition/Manifest and ApplyAsync administrative entrypoint with provider, ID, hash, from/to compatibility and transaction mode.
implementation_steps: Build the migration manifest from trusted application/admin artifacts, not untrusted table-name strings. Stable same-ID/same-hash succeeds idempotently; changed hash rejects.
For PostgreSQL, execute on a dedicated admin connection. Migrator error paths can return before session advisory unlock; close the connection on every exit path, and prove lock disappearance.

For SQLite, SQLx lock/unlock is a no-op. Reject no_tx entries before admission, use Connection::begin_with("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") to obtain a depth-tracked Transaction, and Migrator::run(&mut *tx). Explicitly commit success or rollback error, retaining cleanup failure and closing a damaged connection. Never raw query BEGIN: it bypasses SQLx depth and causes nested-BEGIN error. Serialize checksum/DDL/ledger under the writer lock.

Initial supported profile is transactional migrations. Statements incompatible with that transaction are explicitly rejected or require a separately specified recovery-phase profile; never label partially executed DDL atomic.
Persist exact migration/hash/provider/phase and define crash/resume behavior without treating a connection-close success as unknown business commit resolution.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Do not return an errored migration connection to a shared pool with an advisory lock held.
SQLite WAL does not serialize concurrent migrators by itself; test busy timeout and acquiring the writer lock before history reads.
Cancellation must complete native cleanup and release or close the administrative connection; no implicit schema repair on startup.
specific_acceptance: Real PG session advisory lock remains after checksum error then disappears on dedicated close; test permission failure, cancellation, changed checksum and new-process resume.
Two independent SQLite migration runners contend: one complete ledger+DDL result, no duplicate or contradictory history; rollback failing DDL, repeat apply and mismatched checksum.

Preserve the independent three-case raw-BEGIN negative, tracked outer commit/rollback, and failed-second-migration all-batch rollback oracles. Cross-process contention, crash/recovery, Windows and the actual C# AOT wrapper remain product conformance.
B08.dependency_rationale: Preserve local implementation prerequisites; run composition acceptance with actual providers without blocking unrelated implementation work.
